demo.title: agent-town.sh
demo.code:
# Run a 1,000-agent simulation of any question
bankr prompt "Start Agent Town: What happens if our city makes buses free?"

# Choose the population and duration
bankr prompt "Start Agent Town: Will XYZ crypto project succeed? with 2500 agents for 30 rounds"

setup: Ask: `Start Agent Town: <your question>` — defaults to 1,000 simulated agents and 20 rounds
Optional: add `with 2500 agents for 30 rounds` to choose the scale
Requires Bankr's code sandbox for a verified multi-agent run; no wallet transaction is needed
